package.description: The package at this directory, when it is not a virtual workspace.

dependencies.description: Packages this package may import, keyed by their import aliases.

workspace.description: Workspace membership and shared dependency pins.

native.description: Downloaded native archives and local replacements.

component.description: The package's WebAssembly component interface and world.

unstable.description: Runtime composition declarations that travel with the package.

pack.description: Source and binary archive publication settings.

post-init.description: Commands run only when a developer initializes a project from this template.

tool.description: Input-only configuration owned by external tools; manifest edits preserve its original TOML.

description: Static package and workspace data. Compilation settings belong to the build graph.

name.description: The lowercase package name, distinct from its local import aliases.

version.description: The full semantic version; absent versions are `0.0.0`.

silk-version.description: The compiler version selected by the launcher.

source.description: The module root, resolved relative to the package directory.

main.description: The root module relative to `source`; absent roots use `main.silk` or `lib.silk`.

kind.description: Whether the default command builds an executable or checks a library.

exports.description: Canonical module names that other packages may import.

readme.description: The README path relative to the package directory.

include.description: Additional packaged files and directories, also available through `Package.path`.

publish.description: Whether this package may be published.

Package.description: A package identity and its source and publication layout.

path.description: A local directory, or a subdirectory of the fetched repository or archive.

package.description: The selected package name when it differs from the import alias.

rev.description: A complete lowercase Git commit hash.

url.description: An HTTPS or local file archive URL.

workspace.description: Selects the same alias from the enclosing workspace catalog.

tools.description: Explicitly authorizes this dependency's sandboxed build tools.

Dependency.description: One path, pinned Git commit, pinned archive, or workspace catalog entry.

members.description: Package directories or globs relative to this manifest.

output-dir.description: The build output directory relative to the workspace root.

silk-version.description: The compiler version selected for workspace members.

dependencies.description: Fully specified dependency sources shared by workspace members.

Workspace.description: A workspace's member paths, output directory, and dependency catalog.

archive.description: Archives keyed by their package-local names.

override.description: Local archive replacements keyed by the same names.

Native.description: Native files fetched from pinned archives; compilation and linking are graph operations.

url.description: The portable archive URL, absent when using target-specific pins.

strip.description: The number of directory components removed during extraction.

Archive.description: One portable archive pin or a table of pins selected by target triple.

url.description: An HTTPS or local file URL.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the downloaded bytes.

ArchivePin.description: The verified archive downloaded for one target.

ArchiveOverride.description: A developer's local replacement for a downloaded native archive.

wit.description: A WIT file or directory relative to this package.

Component.description: The interface definition and exported world of a WebAssembly component package.

composition.description: Runtime implementations, defaults, and execution-storage bindings.

Unstable.description: Experimental package declarations whose selected bindings become explicit request inputs.

runtimes.description: Named runtime modules declared by the package.

defaults.description: The runtime names selected by default.

retention.description: Declarations retained regardless of import reachability.

requirements.description: Reserved requirements; the current compiler accepts only an empty list.

Composition.description: Runtime and provider declarations available to compilations of this package.

bindings.description: One binding for each execution-storage operation.

Capability.description: A runtime capability supplied by a complete set of declaration bindings.

operation.description: The operation: create, acquire, release, or destroy.

StorageBinding.description: One operation supplied by an execution-storage implementation.

module.description: The module declaring the retained value or function.

Retention.description: A declaration kept even when no ordinary source import reaches it.

binary.description: Enables binary publication and configures its layout.

Pack.description: Optional binary archives published beside the source archive.

include.description: Additional paths copied into every binary archive.

target.description: Settings that replace the defaults for each named target.

Binary.description: Default binary archive settings and target-specific overrides.

include.description: The replacement list of additional files.

BinaryTarget.description: Binary archive settings replaced for one target; absent fields retain the defaults.

directory.description: The release directory relative to the repository root.

version-file.description: A Silk version constant source file outside `.changes`.

run.description: The executable followed by its arguments.

arguments.description: Whether to append arguments passed to `silk init` after `--`.

PostInit.description: A template command run only by an explicit `silk init` invocation.

Tool.description:
An external tool's table, accepted without interpreting its keys or values.
Decoding discards its contents; a manifest editor must preserve the source document.
